Upstream: background_downloader 9.5.5
Repository: https://github.com/781flyingdutchman/background_downloader
License: upstream LICENSE included unchanged.
Scope: runtime Dart, Android and iOS sources copied from the pinned Pub package.
Examples, upstream development tests and documentation are excluded.

Desktop resume repair:
Capture ParallelDownloadTask parent ResumeData before enqueue. The desktop
worker reads/removes this data when it starts; looking it up after enqueue
can return null and prevent child tasks from resuming.
Android and iOS native runtime sources are unchanged.

Shared retry policy repair:
HTTP429 failures are emitted to the application instead of entering the generic
two-second exponential retry loop. Applies to Dart base dispatcher on all
platforms; native platform sources remain unchanged. Server cooldown handling
is owned by application policy; no protection bypass or automatic mirror storm.
